notes.title: Another day, another Update!
notes.notes:
We've worked tirelessly and released a new patch!

- Improved: Integrated the Intro animation into the Main Menu for even faster game start :)

- Fixed: Issue with the game sometimes not progressing properly
- Fixed: Issue with Matchmaking when starting a match on first Start of the game ever
- Fixed: Occasionally, the Wardrobe Items did not appear when opening the Wardrobe
